uutiset.s: Bloomberg’s Jon Herskovitz discusses the latest exchange of strikes between the US and Iran after American warplanes hit an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps missile launch site in Iran. uutiset.t: Anthropic Crypto Bets Imply $1.7 Trillion Value Despite AI Rout
uutiset.s: Crypto futures tied to Anthropic’s stock market debut have fallen alongside artificial intelligence stocks, but they still imply a blockbuster valuation of about $1.7 trillion, well above the $1.4 trillion the company would be worth at the top of its proposed initial public offering range.

uutiset.t: Treasuries Edge Higher for a Third Day as Risk Appetite Falters
uutiset.s: Benchmark US Treasuries edged higher for a third day, supported by subdued risk sentiment and speculation that most of the Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest-rate hikes may already be in the price.

uutiset.t: Smaller Tankers Join Hormuz Shuttle Trade to Keep Oil Flowing
uutiset.s: Oil is increasingly moving through the Strait of Hormuz on smaller vessels, helping sustain exports as attacks on supertankers squeeze availability of the ships that typically dominate the trade.

uutiset.t: Copper Extends Fall to Near Five-Month Low as Dollar Strengthens
uutiset.s: Copper extended a decline to the lowest in nearly five months as a stronger dollar added to downward pressure from upheaval in the artificial intelligence sector and a gloomy outlook in China for the industrial metal.

uutiset.t: Private Fund Giants Target €80 Billion From EU Insurance Regulatory Revamp
uutiset.s: The world’s biggest private capital firms are stepping up their hunt for a larger chunk of the European Union’s €10 trillion ($11 trillion) insurance asset pile — and settling in for a long pursuit.

uutiset.t: ITPO's Ashraf: India-US Trade Deal 'Almost 99% Done'
uutiset.s: Indian Trade Promotion Organization Chairman Jawed Ashraf says the India-US trade agreement is 'almost 99% done.' uutiset.t: Medline’s Backers Raise $2.1 Billion in Stock Offering
uutiset.s: Medline Inc. shareholders including Blackstone Inc. and Carlyle Group Inc. raised $2.1 billion in a share sale, according to a statement on Wednesday.

uutiset.s: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Sydney with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Paul Allen, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

uutiset.s: Bloomberg North Asia correspondent Minmin Low says Xi Jinping’s speech at the APEC CEO Summit offered few surprises, emphasizing China’s stability, openness and credentials as a testing ground for frontier technologies. uutiset.t: Anthropic-Backer CBA Says Australia More Attractive on Compute
uutiset.s: Australia’s opportunity to provide an outlet for the rising global demand for computing power has increased following the US midterm elections, according to Anthropic PBC-backer Commonwealth Bank of Australia.

uutiset.t: Citi Sees Africa’s Bond Sales Topping 2026 Record Next Year
uutiset.s: The number of African sovereign-bond sales in 2027 looks set to exceed this year’s record as improving macroeconomic stability boosts investor appetite, the continent’s biggest arranger of such debt said.

uutiset.t: Asics Steps Up China Push With Goal to More Than Double Stores
uutiset.s: Asics Corp. plans to more than double its China store network and increase local production as the Japanese sportswear maker makes the country a key growth priority for 2027.

uutiset.t: UBS Group Sees Yuan Rising to 6.25 in Most Bullish Market Call
uutiset.s: UBS Group AG expects the yuan to strengthen toward 6.25 per dollar by the end of 2027, matching the market’s most bullish call yet on a currency that has outperformed most Asian peers this year.
